svg.title: GB202 SM execution and memory topology
svg.desc: Silicon-derived block diagram of an RTX 5090 streaming multiprocessor, showing its shared instruction cache, four subcores, per-subcore queues and collectors, SM-wide MIO, ADU, CBU and LSU services, L1TEX, shared memory and asynchronous-copy tracking.
svg.text: NVIDIA GB202 SM — measured behavioral topology
RTX 5090 / sm_120 · solid = silicon-supported path · dashed gray = equivalent centralized model · dashed red = feedback / completion
Fetch, decode and warp dispatch fabric
four independent subcore streams can progress without slowdown
ICC lookup conflicts depend on relative set and fall-through fetch window
fixed BRA may resolve here without counted MIOC / ADU / CBU execution
